propositions: Winning STATUS transitions to in_progress set compiled plan_review_phase to execution; transitions to open set it to planning; other targets preserve the current value
Execution-phase plan reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 priority blocking floor while planning reviews preserve existing stricter thresholds
Manifest format includes review-phase (planning|execution) and optional priority-floor fields in fixed positions; legacy absent fields parse as planning with no floor

Phase compatibility validation ensures current phase matches signed phase constraints: planning accepts planning/legacy/execution; execution accepts planning/legacy only or execution with floor >= 0.80
Pre-feature snapshots bootstrap phase lazily from compiled status via cache versioning; open/idea bootstrap planning, all other known statuses bootstrap execution

Generation transaction captures phase, floor, material, and relation state before LLM/probe; stable generation equal to initial baseline signs and commits atomically under lock; any stable change returns terminal unsigned stale
